conclusion: The timeout is caused by eager materialization of large deterministic candidate-variation portfolios before hard-gate selection. Individual topology growth calls are bounded and complete quickly; the same six-interface allocation is regenerated more than 120 times.
approved_optimization_direction: Gate the authoritative compiled replay candidate first. Only if it fails, materialize the unchanged remaining candidate sequence. Preserve candidate order, gates, fallback behavior, masks, RNG per candidate, and final selection.
